What these numbers mean

Visits are estimates of people

GoatCounter deduplicates within an approximately eight-hour session window. These are not verified identities or lifetime unique people. Old visits may include your own previous reviews.

Attention is sampled time

Each event represents 15 active seconds. Up to 14 seconds per area and page load may go unrecorded. It estimates attention, not eye tracking; older visits have no section-time history.

No silent demo fallback

Access failures and failed refreshes show an error and the last successful update time. Real analytics never falls back to the fixture.

Cookie-free and minimal

Collection respects Do Not Track and Global Privacy Control. No form input, full query strings, keystrokes or precise location is collected. Owner review can use ?analytics=off on the homepage.
